field.label: Enable Client
field.help: Run the trusttunnel_client daemon on this OPNsense (requires an Active server).

field.label: Mode
field.help: general = route everything through the tunnel. selective = only allowed_destinations.

field.label: TUN interface name
field.help: Letters/digits/underscore, 1–15 chars, must start with a letter. tt[0-9]+ pattern is reserved for this plugin.

field.label: Allowed destinations
field.help: Comma-separated CIDRs to route through the tunnel in selective mode (e.g. 10.40.0.0/24).
